description: This file defines the interface AcknowledgementRequest, which represents a request for a domain-specific acknowledgement in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes static factory methods for creating and parsing acknowledgement requests, as well as methods to retrieve labels and string representations.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequest
classes.description: An interface representing a request for domain-specific acknowledgement, with methods to create, parse, and retrieve acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AcknowledgementRequest instance using the provided acknowledgement label.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into an AcknowledgementRequest instance.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label identifying the requested acknowledgement.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation suitable for parsing.
